variants.name: flag
variants.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: Space Station 14 wall banner sprite, a single game-ready pixel-art asset. Input image is the existing ImperialFlag edit target: small purple hanging cloth banner with a gold circular sun/compass heraldic emblem. Redesign and polish it, retaining the purple-and-gold imperial identity and recognizable circular sun emblem. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, dark outline, readable at 32x32 logical pixels, restrained 12-16 color palette, no antialiasing or painterly texture. Orthographic front view. Single centered complete banner, no text, no mockup, no extra objects, no contact sheet. True transparent RGBA background. Compose on a square canvas as exactly a 32x32 logical pixel sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor; keep all details aligned to that grid. Banner occupies approximately logical x=4..27 y=3..29, so same game scale as reference. Variant 1, REGAL: broad purple draped banner with a slightly scalloped lower edge, rich violet folds, thin doubled gold edging, a clear large golden eight-ray circular sun emblem centered on the cloth, small gold suspension tips. Preserve the reference silhouette closely while improving symmetry, contrast and fabric depth.
